guide.description: Connect Codex to this gateway and check your usage

flow.title: Request flow
flow.description: Codex only talks to the gateway, which picks upstream accounts allowed for the key
flow.caption: The proxy key only unlocks the gateway, upstream credentials stay on the server and never reach the client

steps.title: Setup steps
steps.description: Follow these in order for the first setup and back up any existing config
steps.getConfigDetail: Open the config dialog and copy config.toml for your OS
steps.writeDetail: Merge it into your user config directory without duplicating existing tables
steps.restartDetail: Quit completely and reopen, new sessions read the new config
steps.verifyDetail: Send one message, then look for the new record on the usage page
steps.manualDetail: Includes remote compaction, native image generation, WebSocket and voice
steps.ccSwitchDetail: Writes connection info and daily or weekly budget queries without the advanced settings above

config.title: Config file
config.description: Write Provider settings into the user config instead of only a project directory

fields.provider: Custom Provider ID, keep the casing identical in both places
fields.baseUrl: Gateway URL, the model catalog uses the same prefix
fields.token: The proxy key is stored in plain text, keep it out of Git
fields.websocket: Make sure the reverse proxy allows Upgrade before enabling

models.title: Use non-GPT models
models.description: Codex loads every model available to the current key from the gateway, so models like Kimi are picked the same way as GPT models
models.pickDetail: Choose from the model list, which matches the models available to the key
models.defaultDetail: Add it at the top level of config.toml for new sessions
models.onceDetail: Applies to this launch only and leaves the config unchanged
models.snippet: config.toml example that loads the model list and sets the default model
models.keepProvider: Keep other fields from the config dialog
models.requirements: Required to load the model list
models.catalogUrl: Set it in the current custom provider so Codex loads the model list from this URL
models.discovery: Enabled by default since Codex 0.161.0, add this line for earlier versions

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.login: Check which config directory and Provider Codex actually uses, then quit and restart it
troubleshooting.unauthorized: Check that the proxy key is complete and still enabled
troubleshooting.version: The client is older than the minimum version set by the admin, update Codex and retry
troubleshooting.image: CC Switch imports skip image settings, use the full manually merged config
troubleshooting.models: Make sure the current provider has model_catalog_url and api_key_model_discovery is enabled, then fully quit and restart
troubleshooting.devProxy: This is the dev proxy address, switch to the backend or HTTPS address for daily use
troubleshooting.websocket: Make sure the reverse proxy allows Upgrade, or set supports_websockets back to false
